label: Studio
description: Home, Work, Services, About and Contact for a creative or design studio that wins work by showing it.

site.name: Your studio
site.description: A studio website that leads with the work and makes it easy to start a project.

pages.name: Home
pages.title: Welcome
pages.description: A short introduction to the studio and a way into its work.

sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Introduce the studio in a sentence: what you make, who for and the style people will recognise. Then lead visitors to your work.

sections.title: Recent work
sections.content: Show two or three of your best recent projects here, each with a line on the brief and what you delivered.

pages.name: Work
pages.title: Our work
pages.description: Selected projects with the brief, the approach and the result.

sections.title: Selected projects
sections.content: Add each project with an image, the client or brief, what you did and what changed as a result. A few well-explained projects persuade more than a long list.

pages.name: Services
pages.title: Services
pages.description: What the studio does and how projects run.

sections.title: What we do
sections.content: List the kinds of project you take on and what each one includes, so a visitor can see quickly whether you are the right fit.

sections.title: How a project runs
sections.content: Walk through the stages from first conversation to delivery, with rough timings, so clients know what to expect.

pages.name: About
pages.title: About the studio
pages.description: The people, the approach and what the studio believes in.

sections.title: The people
sections.content: Introduce the people who will work on a client's project, with a line about what each of them does best.

sections.title: How we think
sections.content: Describe the approach that shapes your work, in terms a client would use rather than industry jargon.

pages.name: Contact
pages.title: Contact
pages.description: How to start a project or ask a question.

sections.title: Start a project
sections.content: Tell people what to include when they get in touch, such as the brief, the timescale and a rough budget, and how soon you will reply.
